juggle = to deal with several responsibilities at the same time
settle down = to start living a calmer, more stable life, often with a partner
put down roots = to make a place your long-term home
house-proud = taking great care that your home looks clean and attractive
make ends meet = to have just enough money for basic needs
well-off = having plenty of money; comfortably rich
spoilt = allowed too much and therefore badly behaved or ungrateful
neglect = to fail to give someone or something the care they need
bonding = the process of becoming emotionally closer
strict upbringing = a childhood with many rules and little freedom
sheltered childhood = a childhood in which a person was protected from ordinary difficulties
pastime = an activity you do regularly for pleasure rather than work
unwind = to relax after stress or effort
couch potato = a person who spends too much time sitting and watching screens
take up = to start a hobby or activity
keen on = very interested in or enthusiastic about something
avid = very enthusiastic; doing something as often as possible
household chore = a regular job done to keep a home running
downtime = time when you are not working or busy and can rest
recharge = to rest so that you feel energetic again
